title: Senior Data Consultant
description:
**The Group:**

Morningstar provides independent analysis on individual securities, funds, markets, and portfolios. Morningstar also provides data on hundreds of thousands of investment offerings, including stocks, mutual funds, and similar vehicles, along with real-time global market data on millions of equities, indexes, futures, options, commodities, and precious metals, in addition to foreign exchange and Treasury markets. Morningstar is one of the largest independent sources of fund, equity, and credit data and research in the world, and our advocacy for investors’ interests is the foundation of our company.

**The Role:**

Morningstar Managed Investment Data Team seeks a ( **Senior) Data Consultant / Data Relationship Manager** to champion Morningstar data capabilities in India. The employee will represent Morningstar’s data capabilities to clients and industry groups and return the voice of the local market back to the global and central teams. In this role you are responsible for identifying new data opportunities and will collaborate with teams across the company to define and execute upon Morningstar’s unique value proposition in response to industry trends.

The (Senior) Data Consultant / Data Relationship Manager plays a significant role in ensuring that Morningstar’s offering in the managed investments space exceeds industry expectations. The managed investments space includes, but is not limited to, Managed Funds, Insurance funds, ETF’s, Separate Accounts, Models, and other emerging investment vehicles and marketplaces. All data sets including returns, portfolio and ESG data are within the scope of this role. The position will be based in **Mumbai, India,** and report to the Data Director, Managed Investment Data - Asia Pacific.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage relationships with Indian fund companies and third-party administrators. Visit fund companies and providers to set up acquisition channels as well as acting as a point of escalation when such channels are failing.
* Data expert on investment data points, processes, methodologies, calculations & different fund structures.
* Promote Morningstar data at a local level to internal & external clients. Produce materials to assist retaining & obtaining business.
* Partner with sales, product & support teams on the prospect discovery process & lead generation and serve as the subject matter expert to address data inquiries.
* Collaborate with members of the Global Data teams to align priorities based upon local business requirements.
* Conduct business analysis & manage projects focused on enhancing our database in order to meet changes in our industry and client’s needs.
* Bring back voice of client for data or process enhancement.
* Monitor competitor behavior, trends and services in order that Morningstar are well placed to act on any opportunities that may arise.
* Monitor local asset management industry trends, regulatory movements, and transform them into implications to Morningstar data business.

*.*

**Requirements**

Candidates should have a strong interest in the investment world, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication skills. More details as follows.

* A minimum of **5-7 years of experience** , with demonstrated ability to foster successful external relationships with asset managers, regulator, and third-party data providers.
* Solid understanding of the Indian investment management industry and passionate about investment data.
* Expertise in Morningstar managed investment data, methodology, processes and quality.
* Ability to demonstrate client centric approach.
* Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong learning ability; interested to learn the complex structure of numerous investment vehicles.
* Self-motivated, independent, strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
* A bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, or equivalent is required.
* Excellent capabilities with MS office and Advance Microsoft Excel is required.
* Previous experience in Portfolio Management Services (PMS), Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) and relationship management role is highly preferred.
Prior experience in Morningstar products and services is a plus.  

  

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Database Administrator
description:
**Company Overview**

Teknobuilt is an innovative construction technology company accelerating Digital and AI platforms to help all aspects of program management and execution for workflow automation, collaborative manual tasks and siloed systems. Our platform has received innovation awards and grants in Canada, UK and S. Korea and we are at the frontiers of solving key challenges in the built environment and digital health, safety and quality.

Teknobuilt vision is helping the world build better- safely, smartly and sustainably. We are on a mission to modernize construction by bringing Digitally Integrated Project Execution System - PACE and expert services for midsize to large construction and infrastructure projects. PACE is an end-to-end digital solution that helps in Real Time Project Execution, Health and Safety, Quality and Field management for greater visibility and cost savings. PACE enables digital workflows, remote working, and AI based analytics to bring speed, flow, and surety in project delivery. Our platform has received recognition globally for innovation, and we are experiencing a period of significant growth for our solutions.

**Job Brief**

We are seeking an experienced Database Administrator (DBA) with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle OR PostgreSQL databases, along with exposure to Cloud and DevOps environments. The role involves managing database performance, security, availability, and reliability while collaborating closely with Development and DevOps teams to support scalable, high-availability systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain MySQL / Oracle / PostgreSQL database environments.
* Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity; perform tuning and optimization to ensure optimal performance.
* Manage database security, including users, roles, privileges, auditing, and access controls.
* Design, implement, and manage backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Troubleshoot database issues and provide timely root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Support application teams with database-related queries, schema changes, deployments, and production issues.
* Perform query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance improvements.
* Work closely with DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and infrastructure changes.
* Manage databases in Cloud environments (AWS / Azure) ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.
* Maintain database documentation including architecture diagrams, procedures, configurations, and SOPs.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, and Infrastructure teams to support application releases and system upgrades.

**DevOps & Cloud Exposure**

* Experience working with databases on Cloud platforms such as:
* AWS (RDS, EC2, EKS, ECS, S3, CloudWatch, Route53, Backup)
* Azure (Azure Database services, Monitoring, Backup)
* GCP (Cloud SQL, Compute Engine, Monitoring)
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation (good to have).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Understanding of containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) from a database support perspective.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools used in DevOps ecosystems.

**Oracle DBA (Preferred Skills)**

* Strong experience with Oracle 19c/21c administration.
* Hands-on knowledge of RMAN, Data Guard, ASM, and Oracle performance tuning.
* Experience in Oracle backup, recovery, cloning, and patching.
* Understanding of Oracle licensing and best practices.

**PostgreSQL DBA (Preferred Skills)**

* Strong experience with PostgreSQL administration and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with replication, failover, and high availability (Streaming Replication, Logical Replication, etc.).
* Experience with PostgreSQL backup and recovery tools (pg\_dump, pg\_basebackup, WAL).
* Query optimization and indexing strategies for large datasets.
* Strong SQL and database troubleshooting skills.
* Solid understanding of backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery.
* Experience working in production and high-availability environments.
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Development and DevOps teams.
* Good documentation and communication skills.

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / IT** or related field.
* **3–5 years of experience** as a DBA or similar role.
* Relevant certifications (Oracle / PostgreSQL / Cloud) are a plus.

description:
**Job Information**

**Job Description**
-------------------

**SENIOR DATAOPS ENGINEER (ORACLE ADMIN) (MUMBAI, ON-SITE)**

Joining and work location: Mumbai, strictly on-site at the client

Experience: 3+ years as a production Oracle DBA | Joining: Immediate | Employment: Full time, XenonStack Private Limited

**ABOUT XENONSTACK**

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments. We build enterprise-grade platforms across the agentic stack:

- Akira AI - Reasoning and agent orchestration.

- ElixirData - Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes.

- NexaStack - Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on-prem.

- MetaSecure - Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security.

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI + Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise-ready.

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

We are building a Managed Services team to support a large-scale enterprise data platform. The platform spans Cloudera on AWS, an on-premises Oracle data warehouse, Oracle GoldenGate replication, Apache Spark for ETL and data processing, and Alation for data governance. L1 support is handled by our existing team; this role is part of L2/L3 operations.

**ROLE MISSION**

Own the administration, availability and performance of the on-premises Oracle data warehouse and the GoldenGate replication that feeds the data platform.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Administer Oracle databases supporting the enterprise data warehouse.
* Perform backup and recovery (RMAN), restore validation and disaster recovery drills.
* Monitor and tune database performance using AWR/ASH, SQL tuning and indexing strategies.
* Plan and apply patches, upgrades and configuration changes with proper change control.
* Manage tablespaces, storage, users, roles and privileges in line with audit and compliance requirements.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Oracle GoldenGate replication, including lag, abends and data synchronization issues.
* Handle L2/L3 incidents with root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Support audit requests and maintain DBA documentation and runbooks.
* Guide Junior DataOps engineers on database-related issues.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Managed Services delivery lead; works with the Data Security team and the client's DBA team.

**HOW WE WORK WITH AI**

AI is part of the daily workflow at XenonStack, not an add-on.

* Within XenonStack's own systems, AI tools are open for use: log and incident analysis, runbook and RCA drafting, scripting and documentation.
* At the client site in Mumbai, you follow the client's compliance and information security policy: use only client-approved tools, and never put client data, logs, credentials, queries or configurations into any tool the client has not approved.
* Every AI-assisted output is verified by you before it is relied on or shared.
* Come ready to talk about what is in your AI stack, how you verify its output, and how you keep it compliant in a regulated environment.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Backups verified by regular restore tests; DR drills meet the agreed RTO and RPO.
* GoldenGate lag within agreed limits, with abends resolved quickly and root-caused.
* No unplanned downtime from patches or changes.
* Audit requests answered on time with complete evidence.

**MUST-HAVE SKILLS**

* Oracle DBA experience on 12c/19c in production
* RMAN backup and recovery
* Performance tuning (AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning)
* Patching, tablespace and storage management
* User, role and privilege management
* Linux administration and shell scripting basics

**GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS**

* Oracle GoldenGate administration and troubleshooting (strongly preferred)
* Data Guard, RAC, ASM or Exadata
* Python scripting; exposure to Spark or data pipelines
* Familiarity with Alation

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent; Oracle certification (OCP) is an advantage
* Experience as a production DBA in an enterprise environment; regulated-industry exposure preferred
* Strong troubleshooting skills and discipline around change and audit processes

**HIRING PROCESS**

Pre-screening assessment (about 10 minutes, at application) Technical interview (video) Technical assessment round (live video; in person at our Mohali office for Chandigarh Tricity candidates) HR and Leadership round Background verification Offer.

**TERMS**

* Joining and work location: Mumbai, strictly on-site at the client.
* Immediate joining.
* Regulated production environment; background verification (BGV) is mandatory.
* Support model: 16x5 core support with P1 24x7 on-call, on a rotational basis, as per the client's support model.
* Relocation support and on-call allowance are discussed at the offer stage.
* Compensation as per company policy and budget band.

**HOW WE WORK**

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options, not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort.

**OUR VALUES**

Agency - Be self-directed and proactive | Taste - Sweat the details and build with precision | Ownership - Take responsibility for outcomes | Mastery - Commit to continuous learning and growth | Impatience - Move fast and challenge inertia | Customer Obsession - Always put the customer first

**WHY JOIN US**

* Run a large-scale enterprise data platform.
* AI-first environment: work alongside the agentic platforms we build.
* Great Place to Work-Certified, 14+ years, headquartered in Mohali.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
**Senior Database Reliability Engineer**


**Location: Pune**


* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!


**Who We Are**



Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.



We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.



As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.


**About the Role**



Modulr is a B2B embedded\-payments platform operating at scale in a regulated environment. As we evolve our core data architecture, we’re hiring our first dedicated Database Reliability Engineer to raise the operational resilience of our payments platform.



This is a hands\-on role for someone who thinks like a Site Reliability Engineer but has deep database expertise — someone who wants to make a large, busy production estate observable, diagnosable, and safe to operate, and to be the database voice that shapes how we scale. It carries a clear path toward a data\-architecture mandate as the platform matures.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own the reliability, performance, and observability of our production databases (primarily PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora), so that issues are seen and understood in minutes, not hours.
* Lead deep\-dive diagnosis of production incidents — query performance, lock and wait\-event analysis, connection\-pool behaviour, blocking sessions — and turn findings into lasting fixes and runbooks.
* Build proactive guardrails: query and statement timeouts, connection\-pool standards, slow\-query and contention alerting, capacity and saturation monitoring.
* Partner with engineering squads to design schemas, indexes, and access patterns that scale, and to enforce safe database practices in their services.
* Contribute the database\-reliability perspective to significant platform\-evolution work, including separation of read and write paths and the decomposition of shared database components.
* Improve our database observability tooling and dashboards so reliability is measurable and trends are visible before they become incidents.
* Help embed a culture of operational excellence, blameless post\-incident review, and continuous improvement.


**Person Specification**


**Essential**


* Substantial hands\-on experience operating production PostgreSQL (Aurora / RDS a strong plus) at meaningful scale.
* Genuine SRE mindset: comfortable with observability tooling, metrics and tracing, alerting, automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code — not just database administration.
* Demonstrable strength in performance diagnosis: reading query plans, identifying lock contention and blocking, resolving connection\-pool exhaustion, and tuning for throughput and latency.
* Experience supporting high\-availability, low\-tolerance systems where correctness and uptime both matter.
* Clear, calm communicator who can lead a live incident and explain root cause to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash) and working familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes\-based environments.


**Desired**


* Exposure to payments, fintech, or other regulated, high\-availability domains.
* Experience with data\-observability or lineage tooling and with connection\-management layers such as PgBouncer / RDS Proxy.
* Familiarity with decomposing monolithic databases and introducing read/write separation.


**ModInclusion**



Modulr is a leading fintech platform providing Payments Automation and enterprise payment solutions. We serve high\-growth businesses across multiple verticals including Lending, Travel, Banking, and Core Business Payments, operating across India, the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our mission is to simplify and automate payments for our customers, and we're building a diverse, talented team to support that mission. Our people are central to our success, and we're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
